title: Dragon Ball GT Gave Fans One Of The Coolest Villains (& They Need to Be Made Canon)
content: The recent Dragon Ball canonization of fan-favorite characters and power levels needs to continue by adding in Dragon Ball GT ‘s favorite and only Tuffle, Baby. Dragon Ball GT didn’t deliver the same iconic villains as Frieza, Cell and Buu.
author: ComicBook

title: Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2 Original Score and Soundtrack Albums Released
content: CYBERPUNK: EDGERUNNERS 2 has released two official music albums following the anime’s Netflix debut on October 20, including an original score by Tsuneo Imahori and a separate soundtrack featuring songs from Rico Nasty, Corbin, DOUDOU, BIJI and more. The songs are now available on major music streaming platforms .
author: Anime Corner

title: Manhwa-Based Live-Action Series The Blue Road Releases Teaser Trailer Ahead of November 20 Premiere
content: Netflix released a teaser trailer for The Blue Road , the manhwa -based live-action series , on Thursday. The series will premiere on Netflix on November 20 at 1:00 a.m. PST. The teaser trailer introduces Seoul Metropolitan Police Agency detective Seok Kim (Seok-gu Son) and Tokyo Metropolitan Police Department…

title: Takopi’s Original Sin Movie Reveals Main Trailer With New Scenes, Key Visual and Tele Theme Song
content: Takopi’s Original Sin -Thank You, See You Tomorrow- movie revealed a new key visual and main trailer ahead of its November 27, 2026 release in Japan. The anime originally ran from June 28 to August 1. It swept the weekly rankings every week during its run, taking five wins.
author: Anime Corner

title: Kazumi Yamashita's Twisted Sisters Manga Ends With 11th Volume
content: The 10th compiled book volume of Kazumi Yamashita 's Twisted Sisters manga revealed on Thursday that the manga's 11th volume will be the final volume. The volume is scheduled to ship sometime early next spring.
author: ANN

title: Ghost in the Shell New Anime Project by Science SARU Announced
content: A new Ghost in the Shell anime project based on Masamune Shirow’s manga has officially entered production, with Science SARU once again handling the animation production. title: Though I am an Inept Villainess Anime's 2nd Part Streams Teaser Video
content: The website for the television anime of Satsuki Nakamura 's Though I Am an Inept Villainess ( Futsutsuka na Akujo de wa Gozaimasu ga - Sūgū Chōso Torikae Den ) light novel series revealed a teaser promotional video on Friday for the show's second cours (quarter of a year), titled "The First Royal Outing" arc.
author: ANN

title: New 'Ghost in the Shell' Anime Project in Production
content: The Dover Street Market Ginza Open House public event announced on Friday that a new Koukaku Kidoutai ( The Ghost in the Shell ) anime project is in production, revealing an announcement visual (pictured). Animation studio Science SARU will be producing the new anime project.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Made in Abyss Theatrical Series Part 2 Announced, New Key Visual Revealed
content: The second installment in the new Made in Abyss theatrical series is officially in production, continuing the story after the first film, Made in Abyss: Mezameru Shinpi ( Made in Abyss: Awakening Mystery ). The first film opened in Japan on October 23, 2026.
author: Anime Corner

title: Science Saru's The Ghost in the Shell Gets New Anime Project
content: Bandai Namco Filmworks announced on Friday that a new anime project is underway for The Ghost in the Shell ( Kōkaku Kidōtai THE GHOST IN THE SHELL ) television anime from Science SARU . The announcement did not state the format of the new anime, but confirmed Science SARU will again animate the work.
author: ANN
